scope: Fix SouthReview stopping before Unity on Japanese Windows PowerShell JSON decoding
reported_error: ConvertFrom-Json invalid object / expected colon or closing brace, offset11062
root_cause: BOM-less UTF8 stage JSON was read by Get-Content with Windows PowerShell ANSI/CP932 default. DotNet CP932 decoding swallowed the closing quote after Japanese approval_reference; JSON syntax itself was valid UTF8.

fix: Explicit -Encoding UTF8 on all39 JSON reads in six source-bound review/gate helpers; preserve approval data and original image bytes.

verification.test_environment: PowerShell7 with actual DotNet CP932 decoder and real disk/JSON/approval gates; package suites use synthetic candidate images/mock devices.
